# chat.py - ask Llama 3 a question, one layer at a time
import resource, time
import mlx.core as mx
from airllm import AutoModel

MODEL = "/Volumes/Extreme SSD/airllm-demo/Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct"
SPLIT = "/Volumes/Extreme SSD/airllm-demo/splits"

model = AutoModel.from_pretrained(MODEL, layer_shards_saving_path=SPLIT)

question = "Answer with one word only. What is the capital of France?"
chat = model.tokenizer.apply_chat_template(
    [{"role": "user", "content": question}],
    tokenize=False, add_generation_prompt=True)
ids = model.tokenizer(chat, return_tensors="np", return_attention_mask=False)["input_ids"]

t0 = time.time()
answer = model.generate(mx.array(ids), max_new_tokens=2)
took = time.time() - t0

print(f"\nANSWER: {answer}")
print(f"TIME:   {took:.0f}s for 2 words")
print(f"MEMORY: {resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss / 1e9:.2f} GB peak")
